How the HTML page would work with the clock
1. Web page in the browserShows steps, checks, and progress.
→
2. Local helper on the computerReaches the clock over Wi-Fi and transfers the package.
→
3. Owlanzi on the TC002Queries Owlet directly. No computer needed during operation.

In the real implementation, the helper would serve this interface locally. It would handle Wi-Fi ADB, package verification, and test startup. Ordinary web pages cannot access Wi-Fi ADB directly. Browser integration is a future development step; the local command-line helper already exists.

For future public installation, owlanzi.com could provide the helper and instructions. This preview does not change the website.
